info.title: Alert API
info.description:
The Alert API allows for interacting with Recorded Future Alerts and Alert rules.

Please read the [documentation](https://docs.recordedfuture.com/reference/alerts-get-by-id) before using this API.

get.description: Fetch an alert by id. This endpoint includes all available fields in the response.

200.description: The current state of the alert

Entity.description: A Recorded Future entity reference. Returned as `null` if the requesting user does not have access to the entity.

type.description:
Entity type

Some examples are Malware, InternetDomainName, IpAddress, Hash and Company

description.description: Entity description. Only present when the entity has a description attribute.

AiInsights.description: Recorded Future AI summary of the alert. `text` and `comment` are mutually exclusive: when a summary is available `text` holds it and `comment` is `null`; otherwise `text` is `null` and `comment` explains why no summary is available.

text.description: The generated AI summary text. `null` when no summary is available.

comment.description: Human-readable explanation shown when no summary text is available (for example "Summary is disabled for this alert." or "Summary timed out."). `null` when `text` is populated.
comment.example: A summary has not yet been generated for this alert.

OwnerOrganisationDetails.description: Details about the owner of the alert's rule and their organisation(s)

owner_id.description: Id of the owning user. Only present when the owner is an individual user.

owner_name.description: Name of the owning user. Only present when the owner is an individual user.

organisations.description: Organisations the alert is shared with. May be empty.

UseCaseDeprecation.description: Deprecation notice for the rule's use case. `null` unless the rule's use case is deprecated and the notice is currently active.

from.description: Date from which the use case is deprecated

EntityPathNode.description: A node in a trigger entity path

id.description: Id of the attribute connecting this node to the next

composite_path.description: Only present for composite attribute paths

TriggeredBy.description: One triggering reference and the entity path(s) that matched the alert rule

reference_id.description: Id of the reference that triggered the alert

entity_path.description: Deprecated. The single, shortest matching entity path. Use `entity_paths` instead.

entity_paths.description: All relevant matching entity paths. Each path is an ordered array of nodes.

RuleV2.description: The alert rule that produced the alert

name.description: Rule title, or "No access to alert rule" if the rule cannot be accessed

url.description: Portal URL to view the rule

organisation_id.description: Id of the rule owner organisation

organisation_name.description: Name of the rule owner organisation

status.description: Deprecated legacy review status. Use `statusInPortal` instead. `null` when the alert has no review status.

statusInPortal.description: Alert review status as shown in the portal. Defaults to "Unknown".

statusDate.description: When the status was last changed

statusChangeBy.description: Email of the user who last changed the status

noteDate.description: When the note was last updated

EvidenceV2.description: A single piece of risk evidence showing data that is triggering the risk rule

evidenceString.description: Text evidence for the risk rule

mitigationString.description: Mitigation text. Empty string when no mitigation is available.

ReferenceV2.description: A reference (document fragment) supporting a risk rule or trend

fragment.description: Text fragment summarizing the intelligence match

noteId.description: Analyst note id. Only present for analyst note / Insikt Group sources.

noteLink.description: Portal link to the analyst note. Only present for analyst note / Insikt Group sources.

DocumentV2.description: A source document that contributed to an entity's risk or trend

EntityRiskV2.description: Risk information for the entity. Empty for non-risk alerts; individual sub-fields may be `null`.

evidence.description: List of evidence related to the entity

documents.description: List of documents related to the entity

EntityTrendV2.description: Trend information for the entity. Empty object (`{}`) for non-trend alerts.

name.description: The entity's role in the cyber trend

documents.description: List of documents related to the entity

AlertEntityV2.description: An entity involved in the alert, with its risk and/or trend context

documents.description: Documents for event/reference alerts. Usually empty for signal alerts.

AlertCountsV2.description: Per-alert counts of the intelligence that triggered the alert

documents.description: Number of distinct documents among the visible references

title.example: Infrastructure and Brand Risk, Potential Typosquatting Watch List Domains...

triggered.description: Timestamp of when the alert was triggered

AlertV2Detailed.description: Detailed representation of an alert (V2 lookup and search/details endpoints). Extends the summary with the triggering intelligence.

entities.description: A list of entities tied to the alert

triggered_by.description: A list of entity path chains showing which entities matched which rules/lists

info.title: Alert API
info.description:
The Alert API allows for interacting with Recorded Future Alerts and Alert rules.

Please read the [documentation](https://docs.recordedfuture.com/reference/alerts-get-by-id) before using this API.

get.summary: Search for alerts with extra details
get.description: Search for alerts based on a set of filters. This endpoint includes more data compared to the regular search endpoint.

200.description: A list of alerts matching the search criteria with extra details

TriggeredQueryParameter.name: triggered
TriggeredQueryParameter.description:
The triggered time itself has millisecond precision, but can be searched for using parameters of higher granularity on the form [x, y], which is interpreted as beginning of x until end of y.

For example:
* [2024-08-01, 2024-08-14] matches alerts triggered since beginning of 2024-08-01 to end of 2023-08-14
* [2024-09-23 12:02, 2024-09-23 12:03] matches alerts triggered since beginning of 12:02 to end of 12:03, for example including an alert with triggered: 12:03:58.567

The format of the time is either 2024-09-23 12:03:58.000 or 2024-09-23T12:03:58.000Z (the T and Z are optional). The precision used can range from a year down to milliseconds. On the form [x, y], x and y should have the same level of precision (e.g. date, minutes, milliseconds).
Relative time expressions are also supported, such as -2d, which means two days prior to today and yesterday. As with absolute time references, both ends of the range still need to be specified. For example, to search for alerts that fired within the last 24 hrs, use triggered = [-24h,].
Open-ended ranges is allowed, but will only exclude one single millisecond compared to a closed-ended range, and therefore only make sense to use when filtering on millisecond precision.

For example:
- [2024-09-23 12:03:58.000, 2024-09-23 12:03:58.567) will match an alert triggered at 12:03:58.567 but not an alert triggered at 12:03:58.568.

AssigneeQueryParameter.name: assignee
AssigneeQueryParameter.description: Filter by a specific assigned user, using the email address associated with that user account, or use 'NONE' to explicitly match against unassigned alerts.

LimitQueryParameter.name: limit
LimitQueryParameter.description: Maximum number of items to include

OffsetQueryParameter.name: from
OffsetQueryParameter.description: Offset search from previous result. The API may only return the first 1000 results, meaning that limit + from cannot exceed 1000.

DirectionQueryParameter.name: direction
DirectionQueryParameter.description: Sort direction based on the triggered timestamp

total.description: Total number of alerts matching the query

composite_path.description: Only present for composite attribute paths

info.title: Alert API
info.description:
The Alert API allows for interacting with Recorded Future Alerts and Alert rules.

Please read the [documentation](https://docs.recordedfuture.com/reference/alerts-get-by-id) before using this API.

get.summary: Fetch a flat collection of hits
get.description:
Returns only a flat array of all hits (the Intelligence Cloud data that caused the alert to trigger) for one or several alerts.

This endpoint will also include the alert ID and a numeric index for each hits object.

200.description: A list of hits for the alert(s)

Entity.description: A Recorded Future entity reference. Returned as `null` if the requesting user does not have access to the entity.

type.description:
Entity type

Some examples are Malware, InternetDomainName, IpAddress, Hash and Company

description.description: Entity description. Only present when the entity has a description attribute.

source.description: Source of the document as an entity

authors.description: Document authors as a list of entities

AnalystNote.description: Analyst note referenced by the hit. `null` unless the hit's source is an analyst note.

url.description: URLs to access the Analyst note

portal.description: Portal URL for the Analyst note

api.description: API URL for the Analyst note

HitV3.description: A hit — a piece of Intelligence Cloud data that caused the alert to trigger

fragment.description: Text fragment summarizing the intelligence match

entities.description: A list of entities related to the hit

primary_entity.description: The entity that triggered the signal. `null` for non-signal alerts.

FlatHitV3.description: A hit returned by the flat `/v3/hits` endpoint, including its parent alert id and index within the alert

alert_id.description: Id of the alert tied to this hit

index.description: Index of the hit within the alert

info.title: Alert API
info.description:
The Alert API allows for interacting with Recorded Future Alerts and Alert rules.

Please read the [documentation](https://docs.recordedfuture.com/reference/alerts-get-by-id) before using this API.

get.description: Search for alert rules based on a set of filters.

200.description: List of alert rule definitions matching the search criteria

LimitQueryParameter.name: limit
LimitQueryParameter.description: Maximum number of items to include

total.description: Total number of alerts matching the query

IdName.description: A generic id/name reference (user, organisation, subscriber or intelligence goal)

id.description: Entity id, format varies by entity type

created.description: Creation date of the alert rule

enabled.description: Whether the alert rule is enabled

priority.description: Whether the rule is a priority rule

use_case_id.description: Id of the rule's use case. `null` for custom rules.

owner.description: The rule owner (a user or an organisation). Only present when the owner entity can be resolved; typically an organisation for standard use cases and an individual user for custom rules.

intelligence_goals.description: Intelligence goals that the alert rule is associated with

email_subscribers.description: A list of email subscribers for the rule

mobile_subscribers.description: A list of mobile subscribers for the rule

post.description:
Updates one or several alerts. It's possible to update assignee, status and a note tied to the triggered alert.

There are two types of statuses, the recommended "statusInPortal" and the legacy "status". They are mapped, so changing one will change the other and it is not possible to update both independently.

200.description: A partial view of the updated alert(s). If any alert update fails, errors will be included as well.

id.description: Id of the alert to update

assignee.description: New assignee. Can be an id, uhash, username or email.

reviewDate.description: Date of when the alert was last reviewed

statusDate.description: Date of when the alert last had a status update

statusChangeBy.description: Id of the user that performed the status update

error.description: A list of alerts that failed to update

id.description: Id of the alert that failed to update

reason.description: Error message why the alert failed to update
